div.p: Key 45 is removed from the following 2-3-4 tree. Which is the resulting tree?

img.alt: A 2-3-4 tree. Root contains key 45. The root's left child contains key 20. The root's right child contains keys 55 and 65. Node 20's left child contains key 15 and right child contains key 30. Node 55 and 65's left child contains 50, middle child contains 60, and right child contains 70.
